newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Sabesp to issue $300 mln in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Sabesp to issue $300 mln in bonds.

text.p: Sao Paulo state sewage company Sabesp will issue $300 million in eight- or 10-year Eurobonds, said the company's president Ariovaldo Carmignani.
Carmignani said the company will hold a road show in the U.S. and Europe in the first half of July to explain the bond issue.
UBS, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and local Banco Fator are coordinating the sale, he said.
He said the money raised from the bonds would be used to finance investments and pay off more costly domestically issued debentures.
Carmignani said the company plans to pay off the debentures over the next six months.
Last year, Sabesp made its debut in the foreign debt market by launching $100 million in Eurocommercial papers.
On Wednesday, Sabesp shares began trading on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa).
